name: Christmas Tale
source:
Christmas tale - it's a short choice-based visual novel about two days before Christmas.

You will decide which choice to make, hoping it somehow will change your life.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/765400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《圣诞故事》是一部以选择为核心、讲述圣诞节前两天的短篇视觉小说。

你要作出选择，希望某个决定能以某种方式改变自己的人生。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/765400/]Steam[/url]]
